decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) an abrupt multi-sample shift near the end of the first window (indices 536–544), and (2) a prolonged interval of high-amplitude, irregular motion with missing data and possible superposed offsets from index 605 onward.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in N and E components around index 539–542 (e.g. N from ~10 to ~13, E from ~10 to ~12), followed by sustained elevated levels; U shows a concurrent drop then partial recovery. The transition is abrupt and spans several samples, suggesting a possible permanent offset or rapid motion event.

Persistent high-amplitude variability in all axes from ~605 onward, with notable spikes (e.g. N=21.3 at index 638) and missing samples at 639 and 728–729. A broad platform-like behavior in N/E/U between ~640–670 appears superposed on slower drifts; ambiguous whether some features represent opposing returns or unresolved multi-stage changes due to coarse sampling.
